title: Split the solution into projects by layer

labels:
  - kind: refactor
  - area: build
parent: m2.5-p6-tests-and-layering
---

Layers are folders, so nothing but the cycle test keeps verification from calling the CLI or the model from depending on storage, and the planned SMT, rewrite and solver code would land wherever is convenient.
We want projects whose references enforce the direction: `Model` (networks, rules, semantics), `Simulation`, `Specs` (specifications, contracts, parts, verification), `Search` (tasks, operators, every search), `Compilation`, `Export`, `Storage`, `Application`, and `Cli` as the tool.

Its responsibilities are:
* The projects and their references, lowest first: Model; Simulation; Specs; Compilation and Search; Export and Storage; Application; Cli
* One test project per layer, or one test project with folders per layer if build time says so
* The Metal kernel embedded in the Simulation project, and the tool packaging unchanged

The exact cut may move a type to a lower layer where a reference would otherwise point upwards, and each such move should be listed, because the cut is right only where the dependencies agree with it.
`install-snp.sh` and `dotnet tool install` should work as before, because that is how the tool is used.

Where: `SNP_Evolution.slnx`, `Cli/Cli.csproj`, `SNP_Evolution.Tests/SNP_Evolution.Tests.csproj`, `Directory.Build.props`, `install-snp.sh`.

Done when:
- [ ] The solution builds as separate projects and no project references one above it
- [ ] `sh install-snp.sh` installs a working `snp-evolution`
- [ ] Golden runs unchanged; `dotnet test` green

Read first: README "How to build", "Installing the command", "Extending"
